The '''Coryx family''' was the alias used by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jai Maruk]] and [[Maks Leem]], and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] and [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] when they were traveling through [[Joran Station]] on their way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].<ref name="Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
